clips.title: The story
paras: The Hunter's Path is a rite of passage offered to novice dwarven hunters across Dun Morogh once they reach basic competence in tracking and marksmanship. Local trainers direct their apprentices to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos to begin learning the art of taming wild beasts as permanent companions.

Until a hunter masters the art of beast bonding, they walk the snowy crags of Dun Morogh alone, relying solely on axe, rifle, or bow. Trainers like Olmin Burningbeard and Tristane Shadowstone watch their pupils closely until they demonstrate the poise required to face a savage creature without killing it. Once a novice shows sufficient discipline, they are sent down the mountain roads toward Kharanos.

In Kharanos, Grif Wildheart oversees the final trials of dwarven huntsmanship. Taming a beast is considered far more demanding than bringing one down for meat or pelt; it requires patience, physical endurance, and an intuitive bond with the wild predators of the mountains. Wildheart acts as the gateway to these trials, preparing the hunter for the grueling task of testing their willpower against Dun Morogh's fiercest wildlife.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
You must see Grif Wildheart in Kharanos. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I do believe you are ready, as well....
